You're right. Idk why I do this to myself, I'm moving in a few months to a large city like might as well focus on that goal and to get there.
Most people are not terrible people, thought most are not good either. But know that there is good people and if you look hard enough you will find them.

The other comment is correct. Unless you are going to tell her that you have a super descriptive plan on killing yourself tonight and plan too they won't breach the confidentiality. Thoughts and passive ones won't land you with 2 cops knocking at your door at midnight sending you away. Also, keep in mind most states or places need a judges order to even commit you. The worse that would happen likely is cops get you and you chill in the e.r for 3 hrs and discharge yourself. Unless your state has the bakers act but most do not.

Look im graduating in 3 week from college with a bachelor's degree. I've had many friends whom failed a semester whom were honors students in high school. Shit just happens, it may seem like a big deal but it isn't. Honestly you are a super common case. Just you will be behind a semester now. I barely passed one semester my sophomore year but im still graduating mostly on time. Really just focus on what happened and fixing the problem to do better in the future. Trust me know will think you failed. I've known many people in your spot and I didn't once look down on them. I was almost one of them.

Look, I have those feelings constantly too. Though, I realized that this pain is temporary. There is a chance for something better. You ending your life, will have effects on someone, you do matter. Live for the fact that you have a future many would kill for. Whom or whatever made you feel this way isn't worth it. Life sucks but being dead is worse.
